description.value: Opa! of Greece is a Canadian quick-service restaurant chain serving Greek-inspired food including souvlaki skewers, pita wraps, gyros, and calamari since 1998. The Richmond outlet listed in the chain's store locator is situated at Ironwood Plaza. It is part of the largest Greek QSR chain in North America, with a broad menu suited for a quick, filling stop on a cycling tour.
